sentences.text: Shri Ram Prakash Yadav - Advocate for the appellant.

Shri Manas Mani Verma - Public Prosecutor for the respo
Heard on I.A.No.14491/2025, which is a second application for suspension of sentence and grant of
bail on behalf of appellant-Jaykumar Chourasiya.
First one was withdrawn vide order of Coordinate Bench dated 06.1.2025.

This appeal is filed by appellant being aggrieved of judgment dated 10/08/2024 passed in S.T.No.117/2022 by the Sessions Judge, Shahdol whereby he has been convicted for offence under Section 376 (2)(f) of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.5,000/- with default stipulations.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the appellant that appellant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated.
It is submitted that FSL report is negative.

It is a property dispute between the complainant and present appellant where present appellant has been made scapegoat so to get rid of him from the property where appellant is residing with his mother and ailing father.
There are good chances of success.
Hence, prayer is made to suspend execution of remaining part of the jail sentence of the appellant and to release him on bail.
Shri Manas Mani Verma, learned Government Advocate supports the 2 CRA-9476-2024 impugned judgment and opposes the prayer for suspension of sentence.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and considering the fact that there appears to be good chances of success in appeal, without commenting on merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case to suspend the remaining part of jail sentence of appellant-Jaykumar Chourasiya and release him on bail.
Accordingly, I.A.No.14491/2025 is allowed.
